posts.text: You don’t outgrow ADHD — you outgrow shame.
My ADHD sleep schedule runs on vibes and regret. This hit.
Behind every neurosparkly high achievers in my business is a child who felt out of place until she built a space that finally fit her
The ADHD urge makes me build systems for systems and honestly, I’m proud of the chaos.
I can’t work in silence. I can’t work with music. I can’t work until it’s an emergency.
Pro tip: ADHD is forgetting the simple task, but remembering every random detail from five years ago
